name: Add Custom File Creator to Context Menu
description: Adds a 'Create Markdown File' option to the right-click context menu on folders and the desktop.
folder: Add a Silent Markdown Creator to Context Menu

name: Run .py Files with Python (Right-Click)
description: Adds a right-click context menu entry to run Python scripts directly. Choose between Python Launcher (auto-detect) or system PATH.
folder: add run_with_python option to .py
variantLabel: Choose which Python runner to use:

name: Run .ps1 Files as Admin (Right-Click)
description: Adds a right-click context menu entry to run PowerShell scripts as Administrator.
folder: Add Context Menu option to run .ps1 files as Admin

name: Copy Path Without Quotes (Right-Click)
description: Copies a file's full path to clipboard without surrounding quotes. Uses a VBS script placed in ProgramData.
folder: Copy Path Without Quotes

name: Enable Classic Context Menu (Win10 Style)
description: Restores the full Windows 10-style classic context menu by setting the InprocServer32 registry key, giving you all options instead of the modern Win11 flyout.
folder: Remove or Disable Context Menu Items

name: Fix Alt+Shift Language Toggle
description: Disables the Alt+Shift keyboard layout toggle system-wide by setting a scancode map in the registry. Requires a restart to take effect.
folder: Fix Alt+Shift LanguageToggle

name: Explorer Address Bar: acmd / aps / atr Shortcuts
description: Copies batch files (acmd.bat, aps.bat, atr.bat) to C:\Windows so you can launch Admin CMD, PowerShell, or Terminal directly from the Explorer address bar.
folder: Explorer Address Bar Admin CMD shortcut

name: New Text File Shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+N)
description: Creates a global hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+N) that creates a new text file in the active Explorer folder.
folder: Add a Keyboard Shortcut to create New Text File

name: Set File Explorer to Open Custom Location
description: Makes File Explorer open to a custom folder (e.g. C:\Windows) instead of Quick Access or This PC.
folder: Set File Explorer to Open to a Custom Location

name: Privacy & Telemetry Hardening
description: Runs a PowerShell script that hardens privacy settings and disables telemetry. The script runs in a visible console window so you can track progress.
folder: Privacy & Telemetry Guide
backupNote: This script changes many settings individually — a System Restore Point is a better safety net here than a single targeted backup.

name: Firewall Folder Blocker
description: Runs a batch script that creates Windows Firewall outbound and inbound rules to block ALL .exe files in the selected folder (and subfolders) from network access. Use on folders containing portable apps/tools you don't want phoning home.
folder: Privacy & Telemetry Guide
backupNote: Creates firewall rules for each .exe found. Revert by running: Get-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Blocked:*' | Remove-NetFirewallRule in PowerShell as Admin.

name: Adding Custom Profiles to Terminal
description: A guide on adding custom profiles (e.g. Git Bash, WSL, etc.) to Windows Terminal.
folder: Adding Custom Profiles to Terminal app

name: Pin Keyboard Shortcut to Taskbar
description: A guide demonstrating how to pin any keyboard shortcut to the taskbar. Includes examples for PowerToys OCR (Win+Shift+T) and Windows Voice Typing (Win+H), plus a custom keybinding shortcut generator.
folder: Pin Any Keyboard Shortcut to Taskbar - OCR & Voice Typing

name: Windows Special System Folders Reference
description: A reference guide documenting Windows special system folders (AppData, ProgramData, etc.) and their usages.
folder: Windows Special System Folders and Their Usages

name: Remove or Disable Context Menu Items
description: Block or restore shell extensions from the right-click context menu. Check the items to remove, then click Apply Checked.
folder: Remove or Disable Context Menu Items

name: OCR Shortcut (Pin to Taskbar)
description: Copies PowerToys OCR shortcut scripts and creates a shortcut pinned to the taskbar.
folder: Pin Any Keyboard Shortcut to Taskbar - OCR & Voice Typing

name: Voice Typing Shortcut (Pin to Taskbar)
description: Copies Windows Voice Typing (Win+H) shortcut scripts and creates a shortcut pinned to the taskbar.
folder: Pin Any Keyboard Shortcut to Taskbar - OCR & Voice Typing

name: Custom Keybinding Shortcut (Pin to Taskbar)
description: Create a taskbar shortcut for any custom keyboard combination. Enter the keys (e.g., 'Win+H', 'Ctrl+Shift+Esc', 'Win+I') and it generates the scripts automatically.
folder: Pin Any Keyboard Shortcut to Taskbar - OCR & Voice Typing

name: Add PowerShell ISE to Terminal
description: Adds a PowerShell ISE profile to Windows Terminal. Always backs up Terminal settings.json before modifying.
folder: Adding Custom Profiles to Terminal app

name: Add Git Bash to Terminal
description: Adds a Git Bash profile to Windows Terminal (if Git for Windows is installed). Always backs up Terminal settings.json before modifying.
folder: Adding Custom Profiles to Terminal app

name: Hardware Identity Test
description: Modifies system manufacturer and product name in registry for testing brand-exclusive software. Backs up BIOS registry before applying.
folder: Testing Brand-Exclusive Software - Hardware Identity Modification
backupNote: Backs up the entire HKLM\HARDWARE\DESCRIPTION\System\BIOS key. Revert restores the newest backup.
